regimeSub: Q2 GDP revised up to 2.2% but 10Y blows through 5.26% as Williams warns one more hike still on table.
themes: Q2 GDP revised up to 2.2% from initial estimates (Wed) lifts growth narrative → but 10Y spikes 2bps to 5.26% as markets price higher-for-longer with Fed Funds at 4.0% and Williams still flagging Dec hike risk

Williams (Sep 30) sees 'no urgency' but still expects one more hike by year-end → 2Y eases 3bps to 4.89% as curve steepens to -37bps, pricing extended restrictive stance against Aug CPI at 3.7% YoY and core PCE at 3.0%

Brent surges $7.03 to $103.53 (+7.3% WoW) reversing post-Hormuz easing → Saudi output disruptions per WSJ (Sep 10) reignite energy inflation pass-through risk with WTI at $90.42, undermining Fed's path back to 2% target

KOSPI holds 6900 (+2.8% vs 6714 implied from Sep data) as SK Hynix/Samsung HBM demand sustains → USDKRW at 1358 despite 100bp rate gap widening, BOK faces Oct decision with chip boom cushioning won weakness

headline: Fed's Williams holds Dec hike threat as Q2 GDP revised to 2.2%, but Brent at $103 and 10Y at 5.26% keep stagflation grind intact with inflation stuck at 3.7%.
